_readme: Guide Card catalogue. Edit records here, then run: python3 guide-card/tools/build.py (GitHub rebuilds it for you when you commit this file). See guide-card/data/README.md for every field.

refs.title: Standards in Dentistry
refs.publisher: College of General Dentistry (CGDent)
refs.edition: 3rd edition (year not stated on publisher page)
refs.useWhen: you want the expected standard of care for a routine primary-care procedure — direct or indirect restorations, endodontics, periodontics, implants or dentures.

parts.label: Indirect coronal restorations — crowns, bridges, onlays, veneers

refs.note: Chapter list from the publisher page; individual chapter links are not published, so open the main page.

refs.title: Clinical standard for restorative dentistry
refs.short: NHS England restorative levels of care (L1–3)
refs.publisher: NHS England
refs.ukRelevance: England-only commissioning framework; other UK nations use their own pathways.
refs.useWhen: you need to know whether a case is Level 1, 2 or 3 for NHS commissioning and referral in England.

parts.label: Complexity assessment: levels of periodontal care
Complexity assessment: levels of endodontic care (section 2.2.5)
Complexity assessment: levels of prosthodontic care (section 2.2.6)

keyPoints: Level 1: skills expected of all dentists after foundation training.
Level 2: enhanced skills, delivered on referral with a formal link to a consultant-led managed clinical network.

refs.title: NHS dentistry: care pathways guidance
refs.publisher: NHS England
refs.ukRelevance: English primary-care service guidance under the June 2026 contract changes; not applicable in Scotland, Wales or Northern Ireland.
refs.useWhen: you are planning a 6- or 12-month NHS care package for a patient with extensive caries or periodontal disease in English general practice.
keyPoints: Care pathways introduced 23 June 2026 for patients with complex dental needs.
Pathways 1–2 require care to at least 5 carious teeth; pathways 2–3 require minimum periodontal treatment steps.

refs.title: Restorative Dentistry Specialty Training Curriculum
refs.publisher: GDC (written by the Restorative Dentistry SAC)
refs.edition: Approved 15 Dec 2022; for trainees from September 2024
refs.useWhen: you need the competences expected for specialty training and the Specialist List in restorative dentistry.

refs.title: Syllabus for Higher Specialist Training in Restorative Dentistry
refs.publisher: RCS England FDS — Specialist Advisory Committee for Restorative Dentistry
refs.useWhen: you want the clinical syllabus that accompanies the 2024 GDC restorative curriculum.

refs.title: Restorative dentistry: Index of treatment need – complexity assessment
refs.publisher: RCS England FDS (Falcon et al.)
refs.useWhen: you want a structured complexity code (1–3) across periodontal, endodontic, fixed and removable domains — note the RCS lists it as archived.
keyPoints: Complexity 1: any graduate · 2: experienced practitioner · 3: specialist.
A modifying factor raises a domain by one; the overall code is the highest domain.

refs.title: Dundee Dental Hospital specialist services: restorative dentistry — who to refer / making a referral
refs.publisher: NHS Tayside (Dundee Dental Hospital)
refs.ukRelevance: Local Health Board criteria for Tayside — not national eligibility rules.
refs.useWhen: you are referring a patient in Tayside or NE Fife for specialist restorative care or NHS implants.

refs.title: Implant acceptance criteria — Edinburgh Dental Institute
refs.publisher: NHS Lothian — Edinburgh Dental Institute
refs.ukRelevance: Local criteria for one Scottish service — not national eligibility.
refs.useWhen: you are considering referral for NHS-funded implants to the Edinburgh Dental Institute.

refs.title: Referral guidelines for hospital dental services — restorative dentistry referral criteria
refs.publisher: HSC Business Services Organisation (Belfast Trust services)
refs.ukRelevance: Local criteria for Belfast Trust services — not national eligibility.
refs.useWhen: you are referring to restorative dentistry, periodontics or implants at the Belfast Dental Hospital.
refs.note: The page lists Restorative Dentistry Referral Criteria (March 2016), referral pro formas and dental implant criteria.

refs.title: Delivering better oral health: an evidence-based toolkit for prevention
refs.publisher: Department of Health and Social Care; NHS England
refs.edition: First published 12 June 2014; last updated 10 September 2025
refs.ukRelevance: Published by DHSC/NHS England. The GOV.UK page gives no explicit statement of which UK nations it applies to; it describes a UK-wide expert collaboration.
refs.useWhen: you want evidence-graded prevention advice (fluoride, diet, oral hygiene, tooth wear, smoking) to give patients.

refs.title: Dental checks: intervals between oral health reviews (CG19)
refs.publisher: NICE
refs.ukRelevance: NICE guidance for England; widely referenced across the UK.
refs.useWhen: you are setting a risk-based recall interval for a patient.
keyPoints: Longest 12 months under 18; 24 months for adults.

refs.title: Prevention and Management of Dental Caries in Children
refs.publisher: SDCEP
refs.ukRelevance: Scottish guidance; recommended by the RCS England FDS.
refs.useWhen: you are planning prevention and caries management for a child.

refs.title: The International Caries Classification and Management System (ICCMS™)
refs.publisher: Ismail AI, Pitts NB, Tellez M et al. (BMC Oral Health)
refs.useWhen: you want an internationally agreed caries detection, staging, risk and management pathway.

links.label: ICCMS Guide for Practitioners and Educators (Zenodo)

refs.title: CariesCare practice guide: consensus on evidence into practice
refs.publisher: Martignon S, Pitts NB et al. (BDJ)
refs.useWhen: you want a practice-friendly 4D caries pathway (determine risk, detect, decide, do) derived from ICCMS.

refs.title: Deep Caries Management: EFCD-ESE-ORCA S3-Level Clinical Practice Guideline
refs.short: S3 guideline: deep & extremely deep caries (permanent teeth)
refs.publisher: EFCD, ESE, ORCA and DGZ (Schwendicke F et al.)
refs.edition: Int Endod J 2026;59:1298–1315 (also Caries Res and Clin Oral Investig)
refs.useWhen: you are managing deep or extremely deep caries in a vital PERMANENT tooth and deciding on selective vs stepwise removal or pulpotomy.
refs.note: Jointly developed by EFCD, ESE, ORCA and the German Society of Conservative Dentistry (DGZ) per the PubMed abstract.

refs.title: How to intervene in the caries process in adults: proximal and secondary caries? An EFCD-ORCA-DGZ expert Delphi consensus statement
refs.short: EFCD-ORCA-DGZ consensus: adult proximal & secondary caries
refs.publisher: Schwendicke F et al. (Clin Oral Investig)
refs.topic: Proximal and secondary caries in adults
refs.useWhen: you are deciding whether to monitor, seal, infiltrate, repair or restore an adult proximal or secondary lesion.

refs.title: Best clinical practice guidance for treating deep carious lesions in primary teeth: an EAPD policy document
refs.short: EAPD deep caries in PRIMARY teeth
refs.publisher: European Academy of Paediatric Dentistry (Duggal M et al.)
refs.useWhen: you are managing a deep carious lesion in a PRIMARY tooth (for permanent teeth use the 2026 S3 guideline).

refs.title: Revised FDI criteria for evaluating direct and indirect dental restorations — recommendations for its clinical use, interpretation, and reporting
refs.publisher: Hickel R et al. (Clin Oral Investig)
refs.useWhen: you need a standard way to grade an existing restoration and decide whether to review, refurbish, repair or replace.

refs.title: Tooth Wear Guidelines for the BSRD
refs.publisher: British Society for Restorative Dentistry (Hemmings K, Truman A, Shah S, Chauhan R)
refs.useWhen: you are diagnosing tooth wear or planning fixed or removable management of a worn dentition.

parts.label: Part 2: fixed management of tooth wear
Part 3: removable management of tooth wear

refs.title: Clinical guidelines for dental erosion
refs.publisher: RCS England FDS (O'Sullivan E, Toor I, Brown L, Watkins S)
refs.useWhen: you are assessing or preventing dental erosion.

refs.title: Severe Tooth Wear: European Consensus Statement on Management Guidelines
refs.publisher: Loomans B et al. (J Adhes Dent)
refs.useWhen: you are deciding when and how to restore severe or pathological tooth wear.

refs.title: Basic Periodontal Examination (BPE)
refs.publisher: British Society of Periodontology and Implant Dentistry
refs.useWhen: you are screening an adult's periodontal status and deciding what charting and treatment follow.

refs.title: Guidelines for periodontal screening and management of children and adolescents under 18 years of age (simplified BPE)
refs.publisher: BSP and BSPD
refs.useWhen: you are screening a child or adolescent (7–17) periodontally, including before orthodontics.

refs.title: A new classification scheme for periodontal and peri-implant diseases and conditions — Introduction and key changes from the 1999 classification
refs.publisher: Caton JG et al. (AAP/EFP World Workshop)
refs.useWhen: you need the source international classification of periodontal and peri-implant diseases.

refs.title: Periodontal diagnosis in the context of the 2017 classification system — implementation in clinical practice
refs.short: BSP UK implementation of the 2017 classification
refs.publisher: Dietrich T et al. for the BSP (BDJ)
refs.useWhen: you are writing a periodontal diagnosis (extent, stage, grade, current status, risk factors) in UK practice.

refs.title: BSP implementation of European S3-level evidence-based treatment guidelines for stage I–III periodontitis in UK clinical practice
refs.short: BSP UK S3 treatment guideline (stage I–III)
refs.publisher: West N et al. for the BSP (J Dent)
refs.useWhen: you are planning stepwise treatment of stage I–III periodontitis.

refs.title: Treatment of stage IV periodontitis: The EFP S3 level clinical practice guideline
refs.short: EFP S3 guideline: stage IV periodontitis
refs.publisher: Herrera D et al. (EFP; J Clin Periodontol)
refs.useWhen: you are planning interdisciplinary rehabilitation (orthodontics, splinting, prostheses, implants) for stage IV periodontitis.

refs.title: Prevention and treatment of peri-implant diseases — The EFP S3 level clinical practice guideline
refs.publisher: Herrera D et al. (EFP; J Clin Periodontol)
refs.useWhen: you are preventing or treating peri-implant mucositis or peri-implantitis.

refs.title: BSP Implementation of Prevention and Treatment of Peri-implant Diseases — The EFP S3 Level Clinical Practice Guideline
refs.publisher: West N et al. for the BSP (J Dent)
refs.useWhen: you want the UK-adapted recommendations for preventing and treating peri-implant disease.

refs.title: Prevention and Treatment of Periodontal Diseases in Primary Care
refs.publisher: SDCEP
refs.ukRelevance: Endorsed by the dental faculties of RCSEd, RCPSG and RCS England and by the BSP.
refs.useWhen: you are assessing, diagnosing and treating periodontal disease in primary care.

refs.title: BSP Guidelines for Periodontal Patient Referral
refs.publisher: British Society of Periodontology and Implant Dentistry
refs.useWhen: you are deciding whether a periodontal patient should be referred and at what complexity level.

refs.title: A Guide to Good Endodontic Practice
refs.short: BES Guide to Good Endodontic Practice
refs.publisher: British Endodontic Society (ed. Tomson P)
refs.useWhen: you want UK reference standards for endodontic assessment, treatment, records and emergencies.

refs.title: BES Case Assessment Tool (EndoApp)
refs.publisher: British Endodontic Society (Shah PK, Chong BS)
refs.useWhen: you want to score endodontic case difficulty before treating or referring.
refs.note: Separate from the AAE form and from NHS England commissioning levels.

refs.title: AAE Endodontic Case Difficulty Assessment Form and Guidelines
refs.publisher: American Association of Endodontists
refs.ukRelevance: US tool, also used in UK teaching.
refs.useWhen: you want the AAE minimal/moderate/high difficulty checklist.

refs.title: A Guide to Traumatic Dental Injuries
refs.short: BES guide to traumatic dental injuries
refs.publisher: British Endodontic Society
refs.useWhen: you want a UK society summary of trauma management alongside IADT.
refs.note: Year not stated on the BES page.

refs.title: Dental Trauma History & Examination Proforma
refs.publisher: British Endodontic Society
refs.useWhen: you need a structured record for a trauma assessment.
refs.note: Year not stated on the BES page.

refs.title: Treatment of pulpal and apical disease: The European Society of Endodontology (ESE) S3-level clinical practice guideline
refs.short: ESE S3 guideline: pulpal & apical disease
refs.publisher: Duncan HF et al. (ESE; Int Endod J)
refs.useWhen: you are choosing treatment for pulpitis or apical periodontitis.

refs.title: European Society of Endodontology position statement: Management of deep caries and the exposed pulp
refs.short: ESE position: deep caries & exposed pulp
refs.publisher: ESE (Int Endod J)
refs.useWhen: you are managing a deep lesion or an exposed pulp.

refs.title: European Society of Endodontology position statement: The restoration of root filled teeth
refs.publisher: ESE (Mannocci F et al.; Int Endod J)
refs.useWhen: you are planning the restoration of a root-filled tooth (post, ferrule, cuspal coverage).

refs.title: European Society of Endodontology position statement: Use of cone beam computed tomography in Endodontics
refs.publisher: ESE (Patel S et al.; Int Endod J)
refs.useWhen: you are deciding whether CBCT is justified for an endodontic problem.

refs.title: ESE Position Statement: Root Resorption
refs.publisher: European Society of Endodontology
refs.useWhen: you are diagnosing or managing internal or external root resorption.

refs.title: European Society of Endodontology position statement: External Cervical Resorption
refs.publisher: European Society of Endodontology (Int Endod J)
refs.useWhen: you are managing external cervical resorption.

refs.title: Position statement on longitudinal cracks and fractures of teeth
refs.short: ESE position: cracked teeth & vertical root fracture
refs.publisher: European Society of Endodontology (Int Endod J)
refs.useWhen: you suspect a cracked tooth, split tooth or vertical root fracture.

refs.title: European Society of Endodontology position statement: endodontic management of traumatized permanent teeth
refs.short: ESE position: endodontics in traumatised teeth
refs.publisher: ESE (Krastl G et al.; Int Endod J 54:1473–1481)
refs.useWhen: you are choosing an endodontic approach for a traumatised permanent tooth.

refs.title: European Society of Endodontology position statement: Surgical extrusion, intentional replantation and tooth autotransplantation
refs.publisher: European Society of Endodontology (Plotino G et al.; Int Endod J)
refs.useWhen: you are considering autotransplantation, surgical extrusion or intentional replantation.

refs.title: Guidelines for periradicular surgery
refs.publisher: RCS England FDS with the British Endodontic Society (Qualtrough A et al.)
refs.useWhen: you are considering periradicular (apical) surgery.

refs.title: International Association of Dental Traumatology guidelines for the management of traumatic dental injuries (2020)
refs.publisher: International Association of Dental Traumatology
refs.useWhen: you are managing a traumatic dental injury.

parts.label: Fractures and luxations of permanent teeth

refs.title: UK National Clinical Guidelines in Paediatric Dentistry: Management and root canal treatment of non-vital immature permanent incisor teeth
refs.publisher: Mackie IC — RCS England FDS paediatric dentistry clinical guidelines (Int J Paed Dent 1998)
refs.useWhen: you want the historical UK guideline — check the 2017 EAPD guidance, the 2020 IADT and 2023 ESE S3 guidelines for contemporary practice.

links.label: EAPD guidance on non-vital immature anterior teeth (2017)

refs.note: Published 1998 within the RCS 'Paediatric Dentistry UK National Clinical Guidelines 1999 — Part A', which the RCS lists as archived.

refs.title: Guidelines for the orthodontic management of the traumatised tooth
refs.publisher: Sandler C et al. (J Orthod 2021;48:74–81)
refs.useWhen: you are planning orthodontic movement of previously traumatised teeth.

refs.title: Management of Acute Dental Problems
refs.publisher: SDCEP
refs.useWhen: you are triaging or managing an acute dental presentation.

refs.title: Updating Diagnostic Terminology in Endodontics — a collaborative proposal by the AAE and ESE
refs.publisher: American Association of Endodontists and European Society of Endodontology
refs.useWhen: you want to see the PROPOSED replacement pulpal and periapical diagnostic tables — they are not an adopted standard.
refs.note: As checked: stakeholder feedback stage (hearings Sept 2025 and April 2026); final terminology is subject to AAE and ESE Board votes.
refs.reviewNote: Proposal at the stakeholder-feedback stage; final terminology depends on AAE and ESE Board votes.

refs.title: Crowns, Fixed Bridges and Dental Implants Guidelines
refs.publisher: British Society for Restorative Dentistry (Ibbetson R, Hemmings K, Harris I)
refs.useWhen: you are planning crowns, conventional bridges or implant restorations.

refs.title: Guidance Document: Resin Bonded Bridges (RBBs)
refs.publisher: British Society of Prosthodontics (King S)
refs.useWhen: you are designing or reviewing a resin-bonded bridge, e.g. for a missing lateral incisor.

refs.title: Removable Partial Denture Design
refs.publisher: British Society of Prosthodontics (Stilwell C)
refs.useWhen: you are designing a removable partial denture, including cobalt-chrome and free-end saddle cases.

suiteLinks.label: Design the denture in Chrome Card

refs.title: Hypodontia
refs.publisher: British Society of Prosthodontics (Locke M, Owens J)
refs.useWhen: you are planning restorative management of hypodontia, including missing lateral incisors.

refs.title: Prosthodontic Pathways for Head and Neck Cancer Patients
refs.short: BSSPD prosthodontic pathways in head & neck cancer
refs.publisher: British Society of Prosthodontics
refs.useWhen: you are planning prosthodontic care around head and neck cancer treatment.

refs.title: Guides to Standards in Prosthetic Dentistry — Complete and Partial Dentures
refs.publisher: British Society of Prosthodontics
refs.useWhen: you want BSSPD reference standards for complete or partial dentures.

suiteLinks.label: Design the denture in Chrome Card

refs.title: Guidelines in Prosthetic and Implant Dentistry
refs.short: BSSPD guidelines in prosthetic & implant dentistry
refs.publisher: British Society of Prosthodontics
refs.useWhen: you want the historical BSSPD guideline text (check newer documents first).

refs.title: Guidelines on Standards for the Treatment of Patients using Endosseous Implants
refs.publisher: BSSPD and BAOMS (joint)
refs.useWhen: you want the joint BSSPD/BAOMS standards for implant treatment.
refs.note: Year not stated on the BSSPD page.

refs.title: Guidance on the standards of care for NHS-funded dental implant treatment
refs.publisher: RCS England FDS and Restorative Dentistry-UK
refs.ukRelevance: UK professional guidance; individual services apply their own local criteria.
refs.useWhen: you need the professional standards and eligibility groups for NHS-funded implant treatment (distinct from the archived 2012 priorities document).

refs.title: Guidelines for Selecting Appropriate Patients to Receive Treatment with Dental Implants: Priorities for the NHS
refs.publisher: RCS England FDS (Alani A, Bishop K, Djemal S et al.)
refs.useWhen: you need the historical 2012 priorities — use the 2019 standards of care for current practice.

refs.title: Training Standards in Implant Dentistry
refs.short: CGDent training standards in implant dentistry
refs.publisher: College of General Dentistry (formerly FGDP)
refs.useWhen: you are checking the training expected before practising implant dentistry.
refs.note: Opens the CGDent standards & guidance index; the current edition year was not verified.

refs.title: Mentoring in Implant Dentistry: Good Practice Guidelines
refs.publisher: College of General Dentistry with the Association of Dental Implantology
refs.useWhen: you are arranging or acting as an implant mentor.

refs.title: ADI Dental Implant Placement Guidelines
refs.publisher: Association of Dental Implantology
refs.useWhen: you want record templates and advisory notes from consultation to implant placement.
refs.note: Editions © 1998, 2005, 2009, 2015; file dated March 2023.

refs.title: ITI SAC Classification and Assessment Tool
refs.publisher: International Team for Implantology
refs.useWhen: you want to classify implant case difficulty as straightforward, advanced or complex.
refs.note: Based on 'The SAC Classification in Implant Dentistry', 2nd edition (ITI/Quintessence).

refs.title: Group 5 ITI Consensus Report: Implant placement and loading protocols
refs.publisher: Morton D et al. (Clin Oral Implants Res 2023;34 Suppl 26)
refs.useWhen: you are choosing implant placement and loading timing for a single anterior maxillary tooth.

refs.title: Mandibular two implant-supported overdentures as the first choice standard of care for edentulous patients — the York Consensus Statement
refs.publisher: Thomason JM et al. (BSSPD conference; BDJ 2009)
refs.useWhen: you are discussing implant-retained lower dentures for an edentulous patient (funding criteria are separate).

refs.title: Denture adhesives guidelines
refs.publisher: Oral Health Foundation
refs.useWhen: you are advising a complete or partial denture wearer on adhesive use.
refs.note: Includes a section for partial denture wearers.

refs.title: Denture cleaning guidelines
refs.publisher: Oral Health Foundation
refs.useWhen: you are advising on how to clean complete or partial dentures.
refs.note: Linked from the OHF adhesive page as covering full and partial dentures; the cleaning page's own update date was not verified.

refs.title: Guideline for the extraction of first permanent molars in children
refs.publisher: RCS England FDS (Noar J et al.)
refs.useWhen: you are planning extraction of poor-prognosis first permanent molars in a child.

refs.title: Management of the palatally ectopic maxillary canine
refs.publisher: RCS England FDS (Husain J et al.)
refs.useWhen: you suspect or are managing a palatally ectopic canine.

refs.title: Management of Unerupted Maxillary Incisors
refs.publisher: RCS England FDS (Yaqoob O et al.)
refs.useWhen: you have a child with a delayed or unerupted maxillary incisor.

refs.title: Best clinical practice guidance for clinicians dealing with children presenting with molar-incisor-hypomineralisation (MIH): an updated EAPD policy document
refs.publisher: European Academy of Paediatric Dentistry (Lygidakis NA et al.)
refs.useWhen: you are managing MIH-affected molars or incisors.

refs.title: The oral and dental management of patients before, during and after cancer therapy
refs.short: RCS oral care in cancer therapy
refs.publisher: RCS England FDS (Kumar N et al.)
refs.useWhen: you are assessing or treating a patient before, during or after cancer therapy.

refs.title: Oral health for children and young people with cancer
refs.short: Oral health in children & young people with cancer
refs.publisher: CCLG, RCS England and BSPD
refs.useWhen: you are caring for a child or young person having cancer treatment.

refs.title: Head and Neck Cancer: United Kingdom National Multidisciplinary Guidelines, Sixth Edition
refs.short: UK head & neck cancer guidelines (6th ed)
refs.publisher: Homer JJ, Winter SC (eds.) — J Laryngol Otol 2024;138(S1)
refs.useWhen: you need the national MDT guideline for head and neck cancer care.

links.label: Restorative dentistry & oral rehabilitation chapter (5th edition, 2016)

refs.note: Endorsed by RD-UK. A restorative chapter deep link for the 6th edition was not verified; the 5th-edition chapter is linked for reference.

refs.title: Predicting and Managing Oral and Dental Complications of Surgical and Non-Surgical Treatment for Head and Neck Cancer: A Clinical Guideline
refs.short: RD-UK oral complications of H&N cancer treatment
refs.publisher: Restorative Dentistry UK
refs.ukRelevance: Endorsed by the RCS England FDS.
refs.useWhen: you are predicting or managing oral complications of head and neck cancer treatment.

refs.title: Prevention and Management of Osteoradionecrosis in Patients With Head and Neck Cancer Treated With Radiation Therapy: ISOO-MASCC-ASCO Guideline
refs.publisher: Peterson DE et al. (J Clin Oncol 2024;42:1975–1996)
refs.useWhen: you are preventing or managing jaw osteoradionecrosis after head and neck radiotherapy (drug-related jaw necrosis has separate guidance).

refs.title: Salivary Gland Hypofunction and/or Xerostomia Induced by Nonsurgical Cancer Therapies: ISOO/MASCC/ASCO Guideline
refs.publisher: Mercadante V et al. (J Clin Oncol 2021;39:2825–2843)
refs.useWhen: you are preventing or managing dry mouth after radiotherapy or other non-surgical cancer therapy.

refs.title: MASCC/ISOO Clinical Practice Statement: Clinical assessment of salivary gland hypofunction and xerostomia in cancer patients
refs.publisher: Hong C et al. (Support Care Cancer 2024)
refs.useWhen: you need practical tools to assess salivary hypofunction and xerostomia.

refs.title: Management of painful temporomandibular disorder in adults
refs.publisher: NHS England GIRFT and RCS England FDS (Beecroft E, Durham J et al.)
refs.edition: Clinician summary v1.1 and ultra-brief guide v1.1, August 2025
refs.ukRelevance: Joint NHS England GIRFT and RCS England FDS guideline; UK professional guidance.
refs.useWhen: you are screening, diagnosing and managing painful TMD in an adult.

refs.title: Management of Dental Patients Taking Anticoagulants or Antiplatelet Drugs
refs.publisher: SDCEP
refs.ukRelevance: Endorsed by the dental faculties of the Royal Colleges and CGDent.
refs.useWhen: you are treating a patient on an anticoagulant or antiplatelet.

refs.title: Drug Prescribing for Dentistry
refs.publisher: SDCEP
refs.edition: 3rd edition (Jan 2016); website aligned to BNF 91 (Mar–Sep 2026) and BNFC 2025–26
refs.useWhen: you need a dose or indication for a dental prescription.

refs.title: Oral Health Management of Patients at Risk of Medication-related Osteonecrosis of the Jaw
refs.publisher: SDCEP
refs.edition: March 2017; reviewed and extant March 2024 (with supplement)
refs.useWhen: you are treating a patient on antiresorptive or anti-angiogenic drugs (radiotherapy-related jaw necrosis has separate guidance).

refs.title: Prophylaxis against infective endocarditis: antimicrobial prophylaxis against infective endocarditis in adults and children undergoing interventional procedures (CG64)
refs.publisher: NICE
refs.ukRelevance: NICE directs users to the SDCEP implementation advice for dental procedures in people at high risk.
refs.useWhen: you need the NICE position on antibiotic prophylaxis for infective endocarditis.
refs.reviewNote: NICE's 2024 surveillance proposed updating recommendation 1.1.3; check the NICE page for changes.

refs.title: Antibiotic Prophylaxis Against Infective Endocarditis — implementation advice
refs.publisher: SDCEP
refs.ukRelevance: Supported by the Chief Dental Officers of all four UK nations; referenced by NICE CG64.
refs.useWhen: you are identifying patients for whom antibiotic prophylaxis is recommended or should be considered before dental procedures.

refs.title: Antimicrobial prescribing in dentistry: good practice guidelines
refs.publisher: FGDP (now CGDent) and RCS England FDS (ed. Palmer NO)
refs.useWhen: you are deciding whether an antimicrobial is indicated.

refs.title: Selection Criteria for Dental Radiography
refs.publisher: College of General Dentistry (formerly FGDP; eds. Horner K, Eaton KA)
refs.useWhen: you are justifying which radiograph to take and when.

suiteLinks.label: Audit radiograph justification, grading and reporting in DentalAudit

refs.title: Standards for Conscious Sedation in the Provision of Dental Care (IACSD report)
refs.publisher: Intercollegiate Advisory Committee for Sedation in Dentistry
refs.edition: Published April 2015; updated March 2020 (V1.1); review started 2023
refs.useWhen: you need the UK standard for providing conscious sedation in dentistry.
refs.reviewNote: The publisher records that a review of these standards started in 2023; check for a newer edition before relying on it.

refs.title: Conscious Sedation in Dentistry
refs.publisher: SDCEP
refs.edition: 3rd edition, June 2017; reviewed and unchanged December 2022
refs.useWhen: you are providing conscious sedation in Scotland.

refs.title: The use of general anaesthesia in special care dentistry: A clinical guideline from the British Society for Disability and Oral Health
refs.short: BSDH general anaesthesia in special care
refs.publisher: Geddis-Regan AR et al. for BSDH (Spec Care Dentist 2022)
refs.useWhen: you are planning dental treatment under GA for an adult in special care services.

refs.title: Clinical guidelines to support oral health care for older adults
refs.short: RCS oral health care for older adults
refs.publisher: RCS England FDS
refs.useWhen: you are caring for an older adult, including frailty, dementia, domiciliary or end-of-life care.

refs.title: Dementia-Friendly Dentistry: Good Practice Guidelines
refs.publisher: College of General Dentistry (formerly FGDP; ed. Batchelor P)
refs.useWhen: you are adapting care for a patient living with dementia.
refs.note: Publication year not stated on the page.

refs.title: Oral health for adults in care homes (NG48)
refs.publisher: NICE
refs.useWhen: you are supporting oral care in a care home.

refs.title: Custom-made devices in Great Britain
refs.publisher: Medicines and Healthcare products Regulatory Agency
refs.ukRelevance: Applies in Great Britain (England, Scotland, Wales); Northern Ireland follows different rules.
refs.useWhen: you are writing a laboratory prescription or need the custom-made device statement requirements for crowns, bridges or dentures.

refs.title: ISO 20896-1:2019 Dentistry — Digital impression devices — Part 1: Methods for assessing accuracy
refs.publisher: ISO/TC 106/SC 9
refs.useWhen: you need the test methods used to assess intraoral scanner accuracy — it gives no chairside scan-rejection threshold.
refs.note: Paid standard (restricted full text). Adopted as EN ISO 20896-1:2019; a revision (ISO/CD 20896-1) is in development. BS adoption not separately verified.
refs.reviewNote: A revision (ISO/CD 20896-1) is in development; check the current edition.
